fixed.how: CommandContext.onPersonsWords is set only in code by CommandLoop.commandToolSpecs for a conversation turn that read no record; each planned step and stored call keeps it (CommandCall.onPersonsWords, survives restorePending and recompose). Planning, the decision and the actor rule stay the agent's (ADR 0030 item 2; security-command-actor.test.ts passes unchanged). At the person's yes, executor.perform(steps, ctx, by) runs such steps as the confirming human (marked onPersonsWords), record() authors the row as the person, task.ts writes 'Changed by you: ...', post() files no Inbox Update (personsWords; shared_with fan-out still runs). fixed.problem: L4-selftasks-117: every chat read-back (fix the tasks included) lapsed silently after 10 minutes; an open page kept Yes and the counts; a late Yes said 'expired'.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/chat-fix-tasks.test.ts 'l4-selftasks-chat, run L4' > 'L4-selftasks-117: a read-back left 10.5 minutes and across a restart still waits ...', '... a Yes after the named task was changed elsewhere says what changed and applies nothing', '(run C decision 53): a fix the tasks read-back waits 10.5 minutes and a restart; after the list changed its Yes says so ...', '... an unchanged list's fix set still applies after 10.5 minutes and a restart'; apps/ui/test/chat.test.tsx 'l4-selftasks-chat, run L4: the open chat follows a card answered in the Inbox'; apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts '... GET /commands/pending expiresAt null' (inside the 116 case) and 'L4-selftasks-117: a settings-screen card that still lapses after 10 minutes leaves one Update, an inbox event and a conversation event'
fixed.how: Chat, Talk and voice read-backs have no TTL (expiresAt null, change_card.until_answered, no timer); restorePending arms them again after a restart, also one stored with a TTL by an older version. The Yes is decided on the state then: the card keeps what it named (CommandDef.subjects = task fields via readback-check.ts taskSubject on task.transition/pause/resume/reopen/update/dependencies/split; a value command's oldValue) and confirm compares the card as read back (PendingEntry.shown; the stored card after a restart) with the same request planned now (changedSince): '"Publish the page" changed since I asked: it is paused now. Nothing was changed; ask again if you still want it.' A fix set keeps the task list's fingerprint taken at the check (taskListFingerprint, planFix.fingerprint): 'The tasks changed since I checked them; say "fix the tasks" to check again.' Every other confirmation keeps 10 minutes; its lapse calls ExecutorOptions.onExpired, wired in compose to events.emit('inbox'), ChatTurns.touched(projectId) (conversation.changed) and one Update (lapsedCardUpdate). The UI store reads every shown conversation with a waiting card again on inbox.changed. PendingChangeView.expiresAt is nullable (GET /commands/pending).
fixed.check_in_the_app: 1. In a project's Chat type 'fix the tasks' at Assisted (read-back appears) and, in another line, a priority change the patterns do not parse. 2. Leave the page 11 minutes, then quit and start Forerunner. The card is still in Chat with Yes/No and in the Inbox. 3. Yes makes the change. 4. Repeat, but change the named task (or any task, for fix the tasks) on the Tasks tab before Yes: Yes answers the one 'changed since' line and changes nothing. 5. With the Chat tab open, answer the card in the Inbox: Yes/No disappear in Chat without a reload. Live check (session lead, real model): LC-C28's two read-backs left 11 minutes and across a restart (final_check F-7).

new_problems: Interpretation to confirm (session lead): 'a change that acts at once on the person's words is theirs too' could not be applied to the chat model's acts-at-once calls without failing security-command-actor.test.ts (which pins author_agent for a model-called note_add). Built: the parser's own commands stay the person's as before; the model's acts-at-once calls stay the agent's on Changes but are no Inbox Update; only a read-back the person confirmed becomes theirs.
withoutCardTalk (agent.ts) is a heuristic: a sentence naming the card's quoted task with the card's verb stem is dropped even if it also answers something; needs live samples (LC-C13/C16).
changedSince compares a settings/budget card's oldValue: a value that moves on its own (none known) would refuse a Yes; untested at the real daemon.
A merged card mixing the agent's planFix steps and the person's own step is one change-log row authored by the agent (byAgent true) although its person step's task reads 'Changed by you'.
The fake daemon's chat read-backs have no expiry concept; its POST /commands/execute cards keep 10 minutes, matching the real daemon's ui source.
notes_for_other_areas: CommandContext.onPersonsWords and CommandCall.onPersonsWords (packages/commands/src/types.ts): code-set by CommandLoop.commandToolSpecs for a conversation turn that read no record; executor.perform(steps, ctx, by) runs those steps as the confirming human with onPersonsWords true. Any new command whose run() branches on ctx.actor.kind must decide whether a person-confirmed model call counts as the person (task.ts personsNote shows the pattern).

ExecuteResult pending / PendingConfirmation.expiresAt and PendingChangeView.expiresAt are nullable (null = a chat/voice read-back that waits until answered). ExecutorOptions.onExpired / CommandLoopDeps.onExpired; compose wires events 'inbox', ChatTurns.touched(projectId) and lapsedCardUpdate (loop/answered-cards.ts).
ChatTurns.touched(projectId) sends conversation.changed outside a turn.
